description: Decide whether a university-themed email is phishing and identify the evidence.

items.text: Lookalike sender domain: northbridge-edu.com impersonates the real northbridge.edu domain.
Email authentication failures: SPF fail, no DKIM signature, and/or DMARC fail.
Reply-To address points to a different external domain (mailbox-secure.net) than the From address.
Message was sent from unrelated third-party infrastructure (qx-dispatch.com Return-Path/Message-ID and/or sending IP 203.0.113.87).
The link's displayed text (sso.northbridge.edu) does not match its actual target, which points to a non-university host (qx-dispatch.com).
Urgency or threat: mailbox deactivation and deletion of email within 24 hours.
The message asks the recipient to confirm/enter their username and password (credential harvesting).
Suspicious HTML attachment (Mailbox_Validation_Form.html) that is a credential form or posts data to an external server.
